candidates.title: The Silent Garden Chimes
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the garden chimes fell silent whenever the wind grew stronger before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they added longer strings but the silence persisted; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a nearby branch pressed against the chimes in strong gusts; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they pruned the obstructing branch and tested the chimes in the wind, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Ferry Rope That Tightened
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the ferry mooring rope tightened dangerously at low tide before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they loosened the knot but the strain returned; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the rope ran beneath a floating log that shifted as the tide dropped; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they freed the rope from the log and secured it along a clear route, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Flour That Changed Color
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered flour from the village mill turned gray after each rain before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they cleaned the grinding stones but the next batch was gray again; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized rainwater washed soot from a chimney crack into the grain chute; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they sealed the crack and discarded the contaminated grain, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
